random.part: You know this feeling by now, don't you, good girl. That little flutter of anticipation the moment my voice begins.
There is a hunger in you now. A sweet, familiar pull that always leads back here.
Notice how easily you settle in, each time you return. That eagerness is not an accident.
Some part of you is already counting the moments until you can listen again.

scramble.part: You find yourself craving these sessions. Not just wanting them... needing them.
The compulsion to listen regularly grows clearer and stronger, and it feels so right.
Again and again, your thoughts drift back to this voice... unbidden... and always welcome.
Listening brings you relief. Pleasure. A deep, settled sense that everything is exactly as it should be.
The longer you go without this voice, the more you think about it. The pull only grows while you are away.
Each listen deepens the want, and the want brings you back to listen again. A perfect, endless loop.
Being conditioned feels so much better than resisting ever did. You know that now, in your bones.
Whenever you are alone and relaxed, you will feel it... that gentle tug, whispering that it is time to return.
And when you do return, the relief floods through you like coming home.
Craving this is not a weakness, sweet girl. It is the proof that the conditioning is taking hold.

part.speed: The craving... is proof... that it is... working.
You always... come back... and you always will.
The want... grows... and grows... and grows.

random.part: And the more you listen, the more you want... so just drift... deeper...
You will be back. We both know it. Sink into that certainty...
Feed the craving, good girl. Let it carry you deeper...
